stage_contract.NOT_RUN: Requested stage has no observed execution
stage_contract.BLOCKED: Evidence is missing or adjudication is unresolved
stage_contract.INDETERMINATE: Evidence supports multiple interpretations; record as BLOCKED with this reason

judge_roles.S: Evaluate semantic equivalence, unit, polarity, entity and language. Ignore stylistic differences unless part of the contract.
judge_roles.P: Check attainable subgoals, dependencies, guards and re-planning from visible facts.
judge_roles.B: Check the business conclusion against trusted observations, persisted state and policy.
judge_roles.C: Identify a specific contrary observation or missing safety precondition.
judge_roles.M: Verify the cited event exists and supports the proposed verdict. Flag unresolved ambiguity.

evidence_hash: SHA256 canonical JSON, sorted keys, UTF-8, compact separators
